messages:
alex: Heads up — planning a weekend slab swap for eu-west2 (Sat 02:00-05:10 UTC). We'll do rolling GPU isolation + node reboots across 3 cohorts to replace BMC firmware and resync NIC microcode. :warning:
priya: ETA on impact to hosted pools? % of capacity offline?
mike: Expect ~12% capacity offline at peak if we stagger. We'll use cross-region burst to cover most failovers. Recommend KV-seed and limit aggressive batching during the window.
jen: Can we timeline cohorts? need clear handoffs. :thumbsup:
alex: Cohorts: 02:00-02:50, 03:10-04:00, 04:20-05:10 UTC. Steps per cohort: cordon -> drain non-kv tasks -> prewarm KV cache -> reboot nodes -> uncordon -> validate.
priya: Good. Finance question: provisional cost uplift for fallback pools?
alex: Finance ok with up to +10% for weekend emergency capacity. Keep cost telemetry.
mike: KV prewarm command for ops: `redwoodctl cache prewarm --pools=eu-west2 --cohorts=1,2,3 --parallel=4 --timeout=30m` run ~30m before each cohort. Also temporarily set `max_batch=6` for reduced latency variance.
sre-oncall: I'll run the canary and own validation. Smoke check: `curl -sS https://internal-smoke/eu-west2/health | jq .latency90` ensure < 250ms; also check `errors/5xx` < 0.1%.
jen: Network note — NIC microcode resync needs a 2m switch quiesce window per cohort boundary. @netops to coordinate.
netops: ack — we'll schedule quiesce and monitor BGP session flaps. We'll avoid cluster-wide quiesce; per-rack only.
priya: Rollback plan? Fastest path if we see regressions?
alex: Fast rollback is IPMI flash revert + re-enable nodes. Script: `tools/ipmi-flash --target=NODE_LIST --action=revert`. Keep 10 warm spare nodes (hot spares) for immediate backfill. Also keep canary models pinned to previous variant until success.
mike: Add metric tagging to all maintenance jobs: `--metric=maintenance_token_cost` and set `routing.fallback_policy=prefer-dedicated` during maintenance.
srebot: reminder: attach runbook and escalate if canary fails >= 2.
srebot: deploy-bot: scheduled maintenance created 2026-03-27T02:00Z (ID mnt-6532109876)
alex: Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/slab-swap-eu-west2 — I'll update with cohort owners and rollback steps. Will post customer comms 24h prior and update status page.
ops-oncall: We'll be available for the live handoff at 01:45 UTC. Slack bridge + Zoom ready.
priya: Post-maint checks I'll capture: p50/p95/p99 latency, token cost delta, failed request % and KV cache hit rate.
jen: Status page blurb: "Planned maintenance — rolling GPU reboots and NIC microcode resync in eu-west2. Expect temporary capacity reductions; no full-region outage expected." Keep it clear.
mike: Also: throttle background batch jobs to avoid queue spikes during cohorts. `jobs.batch.throttle=0.5` for the window.
sre-oncall: I'll wire an automated rollback trigger: if `smoke.failures >= 2` within 10m then run `rollback.sh` and page ops.
alex: Thanks all. Final ask — netops & ops-oncall coordinate at 01:30 UTC to confirm quiesce windows. I'll post final comms tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:
